subject: sessiontxn/staleread: don't overwrite StaleTSOProvider for single statement (#65110)
summary: Prevents repeated stale-read timestamp evaluation within a single statement from resetting the StatementContext stale TSO provider/cached value, restoring determinism for time functions (e.g., now() in AS OF expressions). Adds a regression test to ensure repeated CalculateAsOfTsExpr calls yield consistent results; no later upstream/master edits suggest a follow-up fix was needed.
